root.label: Repositories root
root.pickerTitle: Select the folder that contains your repositories

empty.noRoot: Choose the folder that contains your repositories to see their worktrees.
empty.noWorktrees: No git repositories were found under the root folder.

badge.detachedHint: Not on any branch: commits made here can get lost. Switch to or create a branch to keep them.
badge.mainHint: The original checkout of the repository. It cannot be removed from here.

sync.noUpstreamHint: This branch has no remote counterpart to compare with. Push it to publish it.
sync.syncedHint: Up to date with its remote branch.
sync.aheadHint_one: {count} commit not pushed yet. Push to share it.
sync.aheadHint_other: {count} commits not pushed yet. Push to share them.
sync.behindHint_one: {count} commit on the remote that you do not have yet. Pull to get it.
sync.behindHint_other: {count} commits on the remote that you do not have yet. Pull to get them.
sync.divergedHint: Not pushed: {ahead} · To pull: {behind}. The local and remote branches have diverged.

actions.removeMain: The main worktree cannot be removed

remove.message: Remove the worktree at {path}? The folder will be deleted; the branch is kept.

status.cleanHint: Every change in this worktree is already committed.
status.dirtyHint: Files modified, added or deleted that are not committed yet. Commit or stash them before removing the worktree.
status.missingHint: The folder of this worktree no longer exists on disk, but git still lists it. Run git worktree prune to clean it up.
